title: Trending on TikTok & Instagram
dek: What is actually selling and spreading on TikTok and Instagram this fall, each with the dated report behind it.

boards.title: TikTok's best sellers
boards.dek: The chart-toppers on TikTok Shop and the long-running viral buys.

boards.title: Beauty the feed is buying
boards.dek: Lip products, body care and fragrance with big TikTok numbers behind them.

boards.title: Beauty gadgets and tools
boards.dek: LED masks, hot brushes and heatless curls that spread through TikTok.

boards.title: Kitchen and home
boards.dek: Small, cheap kitchen buys from TikTok and one Instagram decor find.

items.name: Smooth & Clear Body Care Set
items.why: A Korean body-care kit for rough, bumpy skin that was the top-grossing product on US TikTok Shop in September 2026, with about 150,000 sets sold that month per Kalodata. FastMoss also ranks it first for the third quarter, at roughly $9.6 million in sales.
items.ebay: medicube smooth clear body care set

trend.note: The No. 1 product by revenue on US TikTok Shop in September 2026 and across Q3.

items.name: CloudAlign Pillow
items.why: A dual-height ergonomic pillow, about $50, that Modern Retail reports has held the top spot in its TikTok Shop category since Mellow launched there in fall 2025. Mellow says it has more than 50,000 creator reviews.

trend.note: Mellow's best seller, at the top of its TikTok Shop category since launch.

items.name: Migraine Relief Cap
items.why: A cold-therapy cap worn over the head and eyes for headache relief. Shop TODAY says it went viral on TikTok and has more than 28,000 five-star ratings on Amazon.

trend.note: Went viral on TikTok as a wearable cold cap for headaches.

items.name: Lip Sleeping Mask
items.why: The overnight lip balm-mask that has been a TikTok fixture for years; Shop TODAY counts 424 million views on #laneigelipmask. It sells for about $24.

trend.note: #laneigelipmask has passed 424 million views on TikTok.

items.name: Maracuja Juicy Lip Plump
items.why: A lip-plumping gloss. Shop TODAY calls it one of TikTok's beauty standouts, with #tartemaracujajuicylip past 84 million views; it is $27.

trend.note: #tartemaracujajuicylip has passed 84 million views on TikTok.

items.name: Unicorn Fruit Body Butter
items.why: A fruit-scented body butter, $32, that Shop TODAY lists among TikTok-viral products; reviewers single out the scent and texture.

trend.note: A TikTok favorite for its scent and texture.

items.name: Glow Reviver Lip Oil
items.why: A $9 tinted lip oil; Shop TODAY notes a single TikTok video about its launch drew more than 13 million views.

trend.note: One launch video for this lip oil drew more than 13 million TikTok views.

items.name: Almost Lipstick in Black Honey
items.why: A sheer, berry-tinted lipstick. It was in TikTok's official gift guide and is still in high demand, per Shop TODAY; $25.

trend.note: Featured in TikTok's official gift guide and still selling strongly.

items.name: Solid Fragrance
items.why: A pocket-size solid perfume, $42, that Shop TODAY recommends for the #perfumetok crowd on TikTok.

items.name: CryoGlow Cooling + LED Face Mask
items.why: Shark's LED face mask with built-in cooling under-eye pads, about $349. Shop TODAY says TikTok users are paying attention to it for anti-aging and acne.

trend.note: An LED mask drawing TikTok attention for anti-aging and acne.

items.name: Thermal Brush
items.why: A heated round brush for blowout-style volume without a dryer, around $43 on sale. Shop TODAY says Wavytalk's affordable styling tools have dominated TikTok feeds, and this brush is its best seller.

trend.note: Wavytalk's best-selling brush, all over TikTok feeds.

items.name: Heatless Hair Curler Set
items.why: A rod you wrap hair around overnight for curls without heat, about $28; Shop TODAY says it has collected thousands of TikTok views.

trend.note: A heatless overnight curl set shared widely on TikTok.

items.name: Rose Quartz Crystal Sculpty Heart Gua Sha
items.why: A heart-shaped rose quartz gua sha for facial massage, $32; Shop TODAY says it gained a lot of popularity on TikTok.
items.ebay: skin gym gua sha heart rose quartz

trend.note: A gua sha tool that grew popular through TikTok facial-massage videos.

items.name: Gracula Garlic Crusher
items.why: A vampire-shaped garlic press that minces cloves with a twist, about $15. Shop TODAY says it has appeared in several viral TikTok videos.

trend.note: Shown in several viral TikTok videos mincing garlic in seconds.

items.name: Powerful Milk Frother Wand
items.why: A battery-powered handheld frother, about $8, that Shop TODAY calls an Amazon best seller; frothers keep trending on TikTok with home coffee drinks.

trend.note: Handheld frothers keep trending on TikTok coffee videos.

items.name: Icon Juice Glass
items.why: A $16 glass that Shop TODAY says became one of TikTok's favorite pieces of drinkware.

trend.note: One of TikTok's favorite drinkware pieces of the past year.

items.name: Mini Ice Cube Trays (2-pack)
items.why: Trays that make small cubes for iced coffee, about $14; Shop TODAY ties them to TikTok's iced-coffee look.

items.name: Sensory Wall Toddler Mirror, Large 1 Bubble
items.why: A convex bubble mirror sold as a kids' sensory toy that stylists are hanging as wall decor; Apartment Therapy found it for about $68 after an interior stylist's video took off on Instagram.

trend.note: Instagram decorators are hanging this kids' convex mirror as a sculptural wall mirror.
